title: How I split LLM dispatch orders from train movement in a Godot rescue sim
author: ViceGodIm
selftext:
I built a little dispatch sim in Godot and put an LLM on the radio. The model sees structured game state and picks one dispatch order every eight simulated seconds. The engine moves the trains and decides when the rescue engine is close enough and moving at nearly the same speed as the freight to couple.



For the comparison I took the recorded GPT run and swapped its first two orders in a scripted replay. It made the cost of waiting a turn visible in metres. I’d be curious whether you’d make the order cadence fixed like this or give the agent a separate emergency interrupt.



The run and replay: [https://youtu.be/hxMcyz4jtf0](https://youtu.be/hxMcyz4jtf0)
